units.source_text: 这常陆守夫人是当时的国守夫人，非浮舟之母。

en.t: This wife of the Governor of Hitachi was the provincial governor's wife at the time, not Ukifune's mother.

units.source_text: 多数注释家皆如此说，惟《花鸟余情》说是浮舟之母。

en.t: Most commentators say this, but Kachō Yosei alone says that she was Ukifune's mother.

units.source_text: 又，这常陆守夫人是纪伊守之妹，但一说是妹尼僧之妹。

en.t: Also, this wife of the Governor of Hitachi was the younger sister of the Governor of Kii, though another account says she was the younger sister of the nun known as Imōto.
